items.title: Is This the Future of Business Class?
items.summary: Alejandro of Simple Flying sits down with Unum Aircraft Seating to explore how the UK-based company is rethinking the modern Business Class seat. From its lightweight design and unique Scimitar seat mechanism to zero-gravity positioning, increased passenger space, and fewer moving parts, the interview takes a closer look at Unum's approach to comfort and sustainability, its upcoming A330 and Boeing 787 certifications, and how its minimalist engineering could shape the future of premium aircraft…
